measurement.profile: 4 logical CPU threads, 8 GiB memory, integrated graphics or Chromium software fallback
measurement.network: production build on loopback; network time excluded from pure adapter and local interaction budgets

resourcePolicy.actionRendering: Render at most one 80-offer batch; reveal later batches on explicit request.
resourcePolicy.historyRendering: Render at most one 80-result batch; preserve an explicitly deep-linked result.
resourcePolicy.animation: Every cockpit animation is finite and reduced motion replaces travel with a direct settle.
resourcePolicy.tacticalRenderer: The three.js renderer is lazy and exists only while the tactical lens is open.
resourcePolicy.projection: Server projection arrays are bounded before serialization and viewer privacy is applied before delivery.
